test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 24 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Fawad starts from Point A and drives 13 km towards north. He then takes a right turn, drives 11 km, turns right and drives 14 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 12 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 1 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again?

(Note: All turns are 90° turns only unless specified.)
solution:
**Initial Position:**

Fawad starts from Point A and moves **13 km North**.

**Step-by-step movement:**

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/efe0dc4ca359be2c72bed5c39fe9d7140a4fbbc2075aa0ec080e5c651cdea151.png] 

**Calculate final position:**

North-South movement:

13 km North + 1 km North = 14 km North

14 km South

So, vertical movement = 0

East-West movement:

11 km East − 12 km West = 1 km West

So, Point P is **1 km west** of Point A.

To reach Point A again, he must travel **1 km towards the east**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
